avoid_supplements.name: Ma Huang (Ephedra)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Sympathomimetic agent causes vasoconstriction and may antagonize hydralazine's hypotensive effects; risk of severe hypertension and cardiovascular events
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated - advise patient to avoid completely

avoid_supplements.name: Licorice Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Causes sodium retention and potassium depletion, leading to hypertension and fluid retention that opposes hydralazine therapy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use only under strict medical supervision with regular blood pressure and electrolyte monitoring

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP2D6 and CYP1A2, potentially reducing hydralazine levels and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid; if discontinuation necessary, inform prescriber for possible dose adjustment

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild stimulant and blood pressure-raising properties that could counteract hydralazine's antihypertensive effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure closely; limit use and inform prescriber

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Hydralazine may deplete B6 and cause peripheral neuropathy; supplementation may mitigate this effect
caution_supplements.action: Consider supplementation (25-50 mg daily) under medical guidance to prevent neuropathy

caution_supplements.name: Coenzyme Q10
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild blood pressure-lowering effects; additive effect possible though generally beneficial for cardiovascular health
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; monitor for enhanced hypotensive effects; may benefit heart function in heart failure

avoid_foods.name: Tyramine-Rich Foods (Aged Cheeses, Processed Meats, Fermented Foods)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Hydralazine may inhibit monoamine oxidase activity; excessive tyramine consumption may cause hypertensive crisis when MAO inhibition occurs
avoid_foods.action: Limit intake of high-tyramine foods; monitor blood pressure; counsel on moderation in diet

caution_foods.name: High Sodium Foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excess sodium can promote fluid retention and hypertension, counteracting antihypertensive benefits
caution_foods.action: Recommend low-sodium diet (generally advised with antihypertensive therapy); monitor fluid balance

caution_foods.name: Excessive Caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: Caffeine may increase heart rate and blood pressure, potentially reducing antihypertensive efficacy
caution_foods.action: Advise moderate caffeine consumption; monitor for tachycardia or blood pressure elevations

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE)-like syndrome with prolonged use. Assess peripheral neuropathy risk and consider B6 supplementation; regular blood pressure and heart rate monitoring essential.
